subject: POC kickoff planning — aligning stakeholders & success criteria
snippet: Confirming multi-stakeholder availability for POC kickoff; capturing success criteria, technical attendees, and procurement pre-reqs.
messages:
From: Emily Cho <emily.cho@novapay.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novapay.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC kickoff — initial scheduling request

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the NovaPay product team is excited to move to a hands-on POC. We'd like to schedule a 90-minute kickoff to align on success criteria, timeline, and owners. Key internal attendees: myself (product), Aaron Li (eng), and procurement. We'll need Redwood AE + SE, and someone who can speak to SSO/hosting options.

Our preferred windows next week:
- Tue 11/10 10:00-11:30 PT
- Wed 11/11 13:00-14:30 PT
- Thu 11/12 08:30-10:00 PT

Can you confirm who will join from your side and what prep we should circulate? Also, any network or account setup prerequisites we should surface to our infra team ahead of time?

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Cho
Product Lead, NovaPay
emily.cho@novapay.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Cho <emily.cho@novapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — initial scheduling request

Emily — thanks, excited to get this started.

Quick responses:
- We'll plan a 90-minute kickoff (agenda suggestion below).
- Attendees from Redwood: Marissa (AE, contracting & timeline), Dylan (SE, infra & integration), and I'll run the success-criteria session.

Agenda (draft):
1) Introductions & objectives (10m)
2) POC scope & success criteria (20m)
3) Integration touchpoints & infra checklist (30m)
4) Timeline & owner RACI (20m)
5) Next steps + action items (10m)

Dylan — can you paste the short network/account prep we should share? I'll also attach a one-pager of success criteria and a checklist for procurement/questions.

From availability above, we can do:
- Tue 11/10 10:00 PT — tentative
- Wed 11/11 13:00 PT — preferred by our SE

If the 11/11 slot works for your execs, we'll lock that. If not, we'll aim for Tue.

Monica Patel
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Emily Cho <emily.cho@novapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — initial scheduling request

Emily / Monica — added our infra checklist stub (attached) with the minimal network reqs. Key asks from NovaPay infra:
- Allow outbound to 13.32.45.0/24 and 52.14.0.0/16 for model inference endpoints;
- If you plan to stage in VPC/on-prem, we need the hostname allowlist and port 443 egress;
- SSO: we support SAML2 and OIDC; if you require SCIM provisioning, that will be scoped as a follow-up.

Attendee suggestion: include Aaron Li (eng), plus your security lead (if available) so we can handle questions live.

Attachment: network-reqs.xlsx (stub)

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: NovaPay Procurement <procurement@novapay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Cho <emily.cho@novapay.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Procurement checklist + contract timing

Hi Marissa / Monica,

Quick procurement note before the kickoff: can you share a short procurement checklist and your standard MSA/T&C timeline? We typically need a redline window of 5 business days and would like to confirm whether trial billing (if any) requires a PO. Also, please call out any data residency or audit obligations — NovaPay needs to feed this into our sourcing docs.

Thanks,
Sophie Tan
Sr. Procurement Manager, NovaPay
procurement@novapay.com

On Tue, Nov 9, 2026 at 11:02 AM Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Emily — thanks, excited to get this started.
>
> Quick responses:...
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: NovaPay Procurement <procurement@novapay.com>, Sophie Tan <procurement@novapay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement checklist + contract timing

Hi Sophie — looping in legal/ops on our side. Quick answers:
- We'll share an MSA + exhibit for POC within 24 hours;
- Trial usage during POC does not require an upfront PO in most cases, but if your finance requires a PO we can accommodate — please confirm preferred process;
- Data residency: for hosted POC we default to US-region; Private deployment options available if NovaPay has stricter residency needs.

Attaching procurement-checklist.pdf and the high-level success criteria doc for the kickoff.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: procurement-checklist.pdf
From: Emily Cho <emily.cho@novapay.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novapay.com, Aaron Li <aaron.li@novapay.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — initial scheduling request

Apologies — exec conflict on 11/11 just popped up. Can we shift to Thu 11/12 08:30-10:00 PT? That slot appears to work for Aaron and procurement. If you can confirm attendees, we'll circulate a short invite list and add our security lead.

If that works, please send a calendar invite and a short prep pack (success criteria + network checklist).

Thanks,
Emily
